h1: The Premium Residence Roi Et — A Spacious City Hotel With Balconies, Steps From the Museum
intro: If you want a city-centre stay in Roi Et with roomy, clean rooms at a few-hundred-baht price, in a spot you can walk to the sights from, The Premium Residence is a name guests bring up again and again for value and spacious rooms · It's a 3-star hotel on Rob Muang Road in the Nai Mueang sub-district — about a 4-minute walk to Roi Et National Museum, and near Bueng Phlan Chai, Wat Burapha Phiram and Roi Et Waterpark · 42 rooms, every one with a balcony, breakfast included, free bicycles to ride around town and free parking, from about ฿580/night · Real guest reviews agree the rooms are spacious and clean, the staff are kind, and it's good value — with a few things on the air-con and bathroom to be aware of.

body.html: The Premium Residence is a 42-room, 3-star hotel in central Roi Et, on Rob Muang Road Soi 1 in the Nai Mueang sub-district · It opened back in 2015, and what keeps it on the city's value-stay shortlist is that the rooms are spacious, every room has a balcony, and rates start in the low hundreds with breakfast included · Rooms come with single or double beds, all with air-con, a fridge, a flat-screen TV, hot water and free Wi-Fi — a good fit for solo travellers, couples and small families who want a roomy base on a budget.

What guests agree on is that the rooms feel large and airy, are clean, and the front-desk staff are kind and helpful, even if their English isn't fluent · A detail many people love is the free bicycle hire — easy to ride around town, since the hotel sits close to the museum and Bueng Phlan Chai · There's an in-house restaurant and bar, a helpful front desk and luggage storage · Breakfast is a simple Thai spread with rice porridge, bread and coffee, which for a few-hundred-baht stay in the city centre still feels like a fair, usable deal.

"Spacious, clean room with a balcony to sit out on · Right in town, you can borrow the free bikes and ride to the museum and Bueng Phlan Chai · Staff were helpful, around 500 baht with breakfast — really good value."

Location is another strong point · The hotel sits in central Roi Et — about a 4-minute walk to Roi Et National Museum, and close to Bueng Phlan Chai (Somdet Park), Wat Burapha Phiram and Roi Et Waterpark · It's roughly a 5-minute drive to the Bueng Phlan Chai area and the 101 Tower (Ho Hod 101) · Convenience stores and plenty of restaurants are nearby, so food is easy to find · Free parking makes it handy for self-drivers or as an overnight stop on an Isan road trip.

To be straight with you, going by real reviews: the things that come up most are the air-con in some rooms not getting very cold, bathrooms feeling humid with a musty drain smell, and beds in some rooms squeaking when you move · Some reviews mention worn pillowcases, a light bulb or two not working, and a bit of dust in the room · Two things worth knowing before you book: there's a deposit that's sometimes slow to be refunded after checkout, and early check-in (before 2 PM) is charged at 100 baht per hour · Breakfast is simple with limited meat options, so many guests top it up at a place in town.

Bottom line: if you want a city-centre hotel in Roi Et that's spacious and clean, has balconies, includes breakfast, throws in free bikes and free parking, and you're not fussed about the building being brand new — The Premium Residence is a solid pick · Its 8.3 from 68 Trip.com reviews (service 8.4 · cleanliness 8.3 · location 8.2 · facilities 8.1) sums it up well: roomy, good service, walkable to the sights, good value — with small caveats on air-con, the bathroom and the deposit · Great for visiting the museum, Bueng Phlan Chai, the 101 Tower, the temples, or for a one-night stop on a budget Isan trip.

A tip from following the reviews here: check the air-con and the bathroom smell when you first get to the room, before you unpack — if it's not right, ask to switch rooms · Ask about the deposit and the early check-in rules clearly when you book or check in, so there are no surprises at checkout · And don't skip borrowing the hotel's free bikes for an evening ride around Bueng Phlan Chai — it's an easy, no-taxi way to see central Roi Et.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — The Premium Residence Roi Et

faq.q: Where is The Premium Residence in Roi Et, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The Premium Residence is at 63 Rob Muang Road Soi 1, Nai Mueang, in central Roi Et · It's about a 4-minute walk to Roi Et National Museum · roughly a 5-minute drive to Bueng Phlan Chai and the 101 Tower · and close to Wat Burapha Phiram and Roi Et Waterpark · Convenience stores and restaurants are nearby, so food and essentials are easy to find.

faq.q: How much does The Premium Residence cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at about ฿580/night for a Standard double · Standard Twin, Superior and Family rooms run roughly ฿620–฿990 · Every room has a balcony · Prices vary by room type and season, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before you book.

faq.q: Does The Premium Residence include breakfast?
faq.a: Yes, breakfast is included. It's a simple Thai spread with rice porridge, bread and coffee, and limited meat options · Many guests top it up at a breakfast spot or café around Bueng Phlan Chai · Check at booking that your rate includes breakfast.

faq.q: Who is The Premium Residence best for?
faq.a: It's best for travellers who want a spacious, balcony-equipped city-centre room in Roi Et at a budget price, within walking distance of the sights · It works for solo travellers, couples, small families and self-drivers who need free parking · Great for visiting the museum, Bueng Phlan Chai, the 101 Tower, or a one-night stop on a budget Isan trip.

faq.q: Are the rooms really spacious and clean?
faq.a: Most reviews confirm the rooms feel large and airy, are clean, and every room has a balcony · Worth knowing: the building opened in 2015 so some fittings show age, the air-con in some rooms isn't very cold, and bathrooms can smell musty from the drain — so check the room's condition on arrival.

faq.q: Does The Premium Residence have free bikes and parking?
faq.a: Yes to both · The hotel offers free bicycle hire for riding around town and Bueng Phlan Chai, and has free parking, making it handy for self-drivers or an overnight stop on an Isan road trip.
